title: MACHINES BEEP WHEN THEY LOCK ON
why: His answer 34 (2026-10-12): machine beeps and pillager taunts. Only the sentry, the crawler and the Crier sounded an alarm when they found you, and the stinger plays once in five seconds for the whole map, so a Warden, a Howler or a Bulwark turning on you made no sound of its own. Now every machine gives a short rising double beep where it stands the moment it locks on to you, once per machine in three seconds, so you can hear what found you and where. Pillagers never beep.
now: Every machine gives a short double beep where it stands when it locks on to you.
